newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFBital issues Q4 financial data.
newsitem.headline: GFBital issues Q4 financial data.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Bital issued the following table of latest financial data for its bank unit Banco Internacional:
Bital said it took the following steps to raise Banco Internacional's capital by 675.5 million pesos in the fourth quarter of 1996.
-- It placed 400 million pesos of mandatory subordinated convertible obligations
-- It raised 507 million pesos in capital via a $90 million loan obtained by Bital in Dec. 1996
-- The rest of the loan, or $20 million, is due to be transferred to Banco Internacional in the first half of 1997.

It also reported that its number of branches as of Wednesday was 1,044 and that in the final quarter it installed 208 cash machines, making a total of 789 during the year. It currently has 1,270 machines, it said.
